papers.title: Formal Epistemic Structures and Mechanics
papers.current_ceiling: The bounded certificate-lifting semantics and exact graph-quality law are supported; broad real-system revalidation authority is not.
post_matrix_updates: Commit 7c472e3 added exact over/under-approximation bounds, cost-minimal closure and exhaustive 3–5-node DAG checks to main.
PR #1733 is an open content-binding subject-commit repair and must remain separate from scientific execution.
load_bearing_adverse: Python import/dependency proxies do not establish authoritative real dependency graphs G*.
The exact graph-quality theorem supplies bounds, not evidence that a chosen extractor is exact on real systems.
Same-programme clean-room replay is reproducibility, not external custodianship.
papers.strongest_remaining_gap: The active campaign must connect the exact graph-quality theorem to authoritative, donor-complete real dependency/change graphs and measure unsafe omissions, conservative excess and revalidation cost.
papers.decisive_question: On RTPTorrent, Bazel and Cargo ecosystems, do theorem-predicted graph-quality bounds correctly bracket minimal safe revalidation, and can the ORION policy reduce work without any unsafe omission?
papers.maximum_claim_if_supported: Graph-quality-aware epistemic revalidation is sound and cost-minimal relative to authoritative dependency semantics across real software ecosystems.
papers.hypothesis_or_theorem: For each real graph, the observed safe revalidation set should lie within the exact under/over-approximation bounds; the proposed closure should match the authoritative minimal safe set or conservatively expose any excess.
papers.population_or_universe: Version-pinned change/dependency graphs from E4, E5 and E6 meeting the active lane's T1/T2/T3 authority rules.
papers.unit_of_analysis: A repository change episode with authoritative dependency graph, changed nodes and required revalidation set.
historical_only_inputs: Python import graphs and any ORION-17 density repositories
design: Defer execution/design changes to the active #1695 lane.
Validate source authoritativeness, extraction and native ground truth before arm output.
Apply the exact graph-quality theorem to each extracted graph.
Compare full reset, exact closure, native ecosystem and proxy-graph policies.
Bind every unsafe/extra decision to a graph witness.
baselines: Heuristic AST/import or donor graph closure.
primary_endpoints: Unsafe omissions, with zero as a noncompensatory gate.
negative_controls: Ground-truth source that fails authority checks and must yield CANNOT_CHECK.
analysis_plan: Exact episode-level outcomes and ecosystem-cluster summaries.
Theorem predictions are evaluated before any aggregate performance metric.
No pooling hides an unsafe omission.
No graph is called authoritative solely because an extractor produced it.
papers.power_or_exhaustion_rule: Use every eligible episode under the active frozen source rule or the full prospectively declared sample; power is secondary to the zero-unsafe gate.
papers.success_gate: Zero unsafe omissions, theorem-consistent bounds and lower unnecessary work than full reset/native donor products on at least two independent ecosystems without failure in the third.
papers.refutation_gate: Any unsafe omission refutes the broad safety claim; loose or systematically violated bounds refute the transfer claim while leaving the exact theorem intact.
papers.cannot_check_gate: CANNOT_CHECK if graph authority, native required-revalidation gold, source licensing or the active frozen protocol cannot be verified.
papers.authority_required: Authoritative ecosystem data/native build systems plus an independent extractor/checker; external maintainers strengthen authority where native logs are incomplete.
freeze_before_outcome: Active #1695 protocol controls all outcome-bearing fields

active_lane.collision_rule: Do not create a competing real-system protocol or alter #1695's freeze; PR #1733 handles binding only.

immediate_safe_actions: Review #1695 source-authority mappings against the exact graph-quality theorem.
Add a theorem-to-endpoint traceability note without touching frozen protocol bytes.
Keep #1733 binding repair independent from scientific claims.
forbidden_actions: Do not substitute import graphs for G*.
Do not run a competing E4/E5/E6 campaign.
Do not promote internal replay to external authority.
papers.journal_bar: A top-tier formal-systems paper needs exact theory plus authoritative real graphs, zero unsafe omissions, native baselines, tightness analysis and independent extraction.
papers.sibling_boundary: Owns admissible revalidation mechanics; navigation/regime transfer belongs to ORION-17.
